name: Sensible Biotechnologies
description: Unlocking the next generation of mRNA medicines

founders.name: Miroslav Gasparek
founders.bio: I am Miro, CEO and Co-Founder of Sensible Biotechnologies. We build a cell-based platform for cost-efficient and scalable production of high-quality mRNA to unlock next generation of mRNA medicines. My background is in computational modeling of biological systems and bioengineering. I have worked on developing Slovak national biosecurity policies - I am passionate about building biotech ecosystem in Eastern Europe. I studied Bioengineering at Imperial College London and Engineering at Oxford.

founders.name: Marian Kupculak
founders.bio: I am Marian, the Chief Scientific Officer and co-founder of Sensible Biotechnologies. We are building a new platform for cost-efficient and scalable manufacturing of high-quality mRNA. I have more than 9 year of experience in biochemistry and molecular biology, more specifically in cellular engineering and downstream processing. I am interesting in engineering cells to produce high-quality proteins and nucleic acids. I did my PhD in Biochemistry at the University of Oxford, UK.

name: SFA Therapeutics
description: Regulating the immune system to block cancer & autoimmune diseases

founders.name: Ira Spector
founders.bio: Dr. Spector is the co-founder of SFA, a microbiome-derived pharmaceutical company focused on new advancements in the treatment inflammatory diseases. An experienced drug developer with over 30 years of experience, he helped develop 34 drugs and 12 medical devices, including Enbrel, Effexor, Protonix, Prevenar, Ozurdex, Botox for Overactive Bladder, Chronic Migraine and Cerebral Palsy. He holds BS degrees in Physics and EE from Washington University, an MBA from Drexel, and a PhD from Rutgers.

founders.name: Alla Arzumanyan
founders.bio: MS is Microbiology, PhD in Biotechnology, Assistant Professor at Temple University, Co-Founder and Co-Inventor at SFA Therapeutics, Inc. Performed a case-control, Proof-of-Activity Human study to evaluate treatment effect of SFA002 drug (proprietary of SFA Therapeutics, Inc.) on patients with plaque psoriasis. Worked with Axella Research on pre-IND application for SFA002. Worked with HEC (Sunshine Lake Pharma Co., China), Theravectys, and ThirdLaw LLC (still collaborating with the latter)

founders.name: Mark Feitelson
founders.bio: Mark Feitelson received his Ph.D. in Microbiology/Immunology from UCLA. He began his work with hepatitis B at Stanford University, and was then recruited to the Fox Chase Cancer Center by Dr. Baruch Blumberg (Nobel laureate). In 1991, Dr. Feitelson moved to Thomas Jefferson University, and in 2007, to Temple University as a Professor of Biology. His work has been supported by NIH, industry and foundations. He has more than 150 publications and 180 abstracts. He is also CSO of SFA Therapeutics.

He is an expert in cancer research, genomics and bioinformatics and has published over 25 articles in peer-reviewed journals such as Nature and has obtained nationally competitive grants. Prior to EUGIT, he was a scientist at 23andMe and a tenure track lecturer at the University of Edinburgh, UK. Nizar grew up in Toronto and obtained his PhD in Biophysics from Stanford.

In 2015, she was the USA and French Div 1 National Champion in the sport of epee fencing. Vicki received her MS in Computer Science - Machine Learning from Columbia University.

founders.name: Ruby Yu
founders.bio: Ruby has spent the past decade investigating gene expression in organisms ranging from yeast to humans, and she is an industry-leading expert on high-throughput genetic screens for machine learning. She received both her BA and her PhD in Biological and Biomedical Sciences from Harvard University. Her extra-laboratorial activities include circus arts, climbing, and cat-sitting.

founders.name: Eta Atolia
founders.bio: Founder & CEO, TareBio (YC S26). MD-PhD from UCLA-Caltech, where she built a novel platform that develops vaccines for any cancer or infection in weeks, funded by the Gates Foundation. BS in Biology from MIT. Conducted research at the Koch Institute, Harvard Medical School, and the Weizmann. Select Awards: UCLA MD-PhD Merit Scholar, UCLA TDG Senior Fellow, MIT iGEM Gold Medal, MIT IDEAs winner, MIT Dean Advisory Group, WhiteHouse Science Fair, Bessie Lawrence Scholar, Intel STS Finalist

name: Nitroduck
description: Monsanto for yummy crops, but without pesticides

founders.name: Matej Zamecnik
founders.bio: Co-founder & CEO at Nitroduck (YC F26). Led 21 students to the Grand Prize at iGEM, the world's biggest biotech competition, by making duckweed, the fastest-growing plant on Earth, programmable. Before that, he co-founded Spicy Cells, building bioreactors to grow saffron as plant cell cultures. Researched at CEITEC. MS in Plant Experimental Biology, Masaryk University.

founders.name: Matúš Grieš
founders.bio: Co-founder & CTO at Nitroduck (YC F26). I co-led iGEM Brno 2025 to Grand Prize against 330 teams including Stanford and Oxford. I worked at Karolinska Institutet (Amgen Scholars), building nanoparticles for drug delivery to placenta and at CEITEC, where I demonstrated plant telomere proteins bind human DNA more tightly than their own. I'm a National Decathlon Champion and 13x silver medalist in triple jump and high jump.

founders.name: Miro Rosputinský
founders.bio: Co-founder & CSO at Nitroduck. Won the iGEM Grand Prize against 330 teams. Research fellow at Weizmann Institute (<1% acceptance) where I engineered cotton to produce spider silk proteins and potatoes to make barnacle adhesive. Built the first metabolic model of a bioplastic-producing bacterium.

name: Primordiant
description: Autonomous labs run by AI and robot scientists, available as an API.

founders.name: Owen Tower
founders.bio: Founder at Primordiant (formerly SuperRadiant). PhD in Physics from Brown, where he invented novel algorithms to discover phase transitions in random-field Ising models, in addition to using micro and nanofluidics to study analogous system experimentally. Research experience at NASA JPL and CERN/LHC. Trained in nanofabrication, microfluidics, and ML methods including PINNs and reinforcement learning.

founders.name: Cooper Niu
founders.bio: Founder of Primordiant. PhD in Physics from Brown University. Researches LLM and AI agents for scientific discovery. Created ALBERT, an autonomous AI particle physicist that proposes, verifies, and iteratively refines physical theories; given only pre-1990 data, it recovered the top quark’s mass and properties in under an hour. Previously worked on neutrino physics with the NOvA experiment at Fermilab and on LHC experiments at CERN.

founders.name: Benedict Quartey
founders.bio: CS PhD from Brown. Pioneered generally capable yet verifiable robot autonomy, combining foundation models with symbolic planning and spatial world models so robots can follow open-ended instructions with guarantees. Built LIMP (ICRA 2025; best paper finalist, TAMP@ICRA), the first system to do this in real-world environments without prebuilt maps, and PACTS (IROS 2026), learned skills that compose zero-shot. Previously at the Boston Dynamics Robotics & AI Institute.

name: Lux Foods
description: Crops engineered for premium fruit, grown without sunlight.

founders.name: Andre Yeung
founders.bio: CEO & co-founder at Lux Foods. Stanford BioE/Computer Science (AI) B.S./B.S.. First lab student in Dr. Robert Jinkerson's lab at UC Riverside, leading project on endosymbiotic gene transfer in algae. Previously student researcher at Brophy Lab working on synthetic genetic circuits in plants. Founded Fruit for Homeless nonprofit, leading 25 students to rescue and distribute 300,000 pounds of fresh fruit to underserved LA communities. Regeneron STS Semi-finalist, iGEM silver medalist.

founders.name: Robert Jinkerson
founders.bio: Co-founder & CSO at Lux Foods. Professor of Chemical Engineering at UC Riverside since 2017, engineering crops for controlled environments and space. Led the UCR team that won NASA's Deep Space Food Challenge and flew cherry tomatoes to the ISS. NSF CAREER Award, FFAR New Innovator Award. Showed plants can grow on acetate without sunlight (Nature Food 2022). Previously postdoc at Stanford; PhD, Colorado School of Mines.

name: BioDelivera

founders.name: Ikeda Trashi
founders.bio: Co-founder & CEO of BioDelivera (YC F26), building GCV™ for precise, tissue-specific delivery of next-generation therapeutics. Repeat founder and PhD I am dedicated in enabling cures for every disease.

founders.name: Orikeda Trashi
founders.bio: Co-founder & President of BioDelivera (YC F26), building GCV™ for precise, programmable drug delivery to enable cures for every patient, across every disease. During her PhD, she spent five years researching drug delivery systems, developing the foundation for the Guided Chimeric Vehicle (GCV) platform.

name: Canos

founders.name: Ming-shan Tsai
founders.bio: Founder/CEO at Canos. Previously co-founded and CSO of ZYTCA, built the best team in animal health, and launched multiple veterinary diagnostic products from 0 to 1, including an AI-driven digital pathology system distributed to 10,000+ vet clinics in China. Pivoted from business management to an Oxford biology PhD, from human health to animal health, and from infectious disease to cancer. I'm unstoppable when it comes to solving problems for animals. Our pets deserve the best tech.
